title: Predicting acute food crises and discovering actionable drivers with causal machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.34629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Acute food insecurity is driven by a compound of conflict, adverse climate events, displacement, and economic shocks. We enrich the open-access Harmonized Food Insecurity Dataset with driver variables (monthly, subnational, 80 countries, 2007--2024) and develop missing-data-resilient machine learning pipelines forecasting crisis occurrence at 3, 6, and 9-month lead times using both FEWS NET and, for the first time at scale, IPC/CH classifications. Pipelines, evaluated through nested cross-validation, outperform no-skill baselines by 15 to 50 percentage points in PR-AUC, with performance correlated with crisis prevalence rather than the classification system. TreeSHAP-based explainability reveals compound, geography-specific predictive signal profiles, with three recurrent forecasting archetypes. translated_title: 基于因果机器学习预测急性粮食危机并发现可干预的驱动因素
translated_abstract: 急性粮食不安全由冲突、不利气候事件、人口流离失所和经济冲击的复合作用所驱动。我们利用驱动因素变量（月度、次国家级、覆盖80个国家、2007–2024年）丰富了开放获取的统一粮食不安全数据集，并开发了能够应对数据缺失的机器学习预测流程，可在3、6和9个月的提前期预测危机发生，同时使用FEWS NET分类体系，并首次大规模采用IPC/CH分类体系。经过嵌套交叉验证评估的预测流程在PR-AUC指标上比无技能基线高出15至50个百分点，且其性能与危机流行率相关，而与所采用的分类体系无关。基于TreeSHAP的可解释性分析揭示了复合的、具有地域特异性的预测信号特征，并归纳出三种反复出现的预测模式。通过将预测重要性与针对可干预驱动因素的双重稳健因果估计进行比较，我们发现急性冲突事件具有最……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了包含驱动因素变量的粮食不安全数据集，开发了缺失数据鲁棒的机器学习流程以在3至9个月提前期预测急性粮食危机，并通过因果机器学习方法对比预测重要性与因果估计，识别出可干预的危机驱动因素。
en_tdlr: This study develops an enriched food insecurity dataset with driver variables and missing-data-resilient machine learning pipelines to forecast acute food crises at 3–9 month lead times, and uses causal machine learning to compare predictive importance with doubly robust causal estimates to identify actionable drivers.
